def VTask.ofLeftInverse {α : Sort u_3} {β : Type u_4} (f : α → β) (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) (hf : ∀ h : Nonempty α, Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) where
  toFun := λ a => ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  invFun := λ ⟨b, hb⟩ => let hα := Nonempty.ofExists hb; f_inv hα b
  left_inv := by
    intro a
    let hα := Nonempty.ofExists (SetLike.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩)
    rw [hf hα (f a)]
  right_inv := by
    intro ⟨b, hb⟩
    cases hb
    case exists.intro x hx =>
      let hα := Nonempty.ofExists ⟨x, hx⟩
      let a := f_inv hα b
      have a_eq_x : a = x := by
        rw [← hx]
        apply hf hα (f x)
      have f_a_eq_b : f a = b := by
        rw [a_eq_x, hx]
      show ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩ = ⟨b, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
      congr
      · exact f_a_eq_b
      · rfl
